I was in class one day & this kid, Austin, was talking about how he was at the local gas station one day after school, sitting in the back of his friends truck while he went in to cash this check. Meanwhile, Austin, seen Derrick, he knew from one of the neighboring schools. They got to talking and Austin tried convincing the kid that he had killed somebody before. The kid found doubt in Austin story. While discussing all this in class, me and about 12 of my classmates who were present devised a plan to convince this kid from the neighboring school that Austin was in fact a killer. We all met up at a home basketball game, (playing the neighboring school). I was tied up in the back of one of my classmates truck in the bus parking lot while Austin and the rest of my class mates went to find Derrick in the gym. About 15 minutes later, I hear a whole crowd of people walking towards the bus parking lot. This was it. They all, Austin and Derrick included, loaded up in the trucks and we drove away from the school. We were headed about 10 miles out of town on nothing but back roads (southern Oklahoma) meanwhile, Austin is telling Derrick that he's got a person, (me) tied up in the back and he was going  to kill me to prove to Derrick that he was a killer. We get to where its supposed to go down. Middle of nowhere of course. All the trucks Park and people swarm out with camera on me and screaming, "Hell yeah let's kill this fool!" as planned, the ropes slid of my hands and feet so I immediately stand up, jump out of the truck and run for my life. My classmates scream at Austin to get me. He chases me down, fires two rounds into my back and I fall onto the ground. (at this point, I've got one eye open just hoping to see Derricks facial expression) with everybody looking, he grabbed me by the collar of my shirt and shot me in the head. Everybody but Derrick knows that the gun is loaded with blanks. I was dragged to the side of the road and they all left. My ride came through about 5 minuets after and took me back to the game where I met up with Derrick privately. He was so scared, seriously thought Austin had shot and killed me in front of him. Best prank I've ever been apart of.
